about.description: Matrixdock provides tokenized access to physical commodities and precious metals through blockchain infrastructure. It enables fractional ownership and efficient settlement of commodity positions.
about.registryInfo: Matrixdock (operated by Matrixport / Matrix Finance Holdings Limited; BVI). Singapore-headquartered tokenized-RWA platform launched 2023. Issues STBT (Short-Term Treasury Bill Token), XAUm (gold-backed) and XAGm (silver-backed) tokens. Matrixport group operates regulated digital-asset financial services in Singapore (MAS-licensed Major Payment Institution and SFC HK Type 1/4/9).

fees.revenueNotes: Matrixdock STBT (Short-Term Treasury Bill Token): 30 bps annual management fee, 0% performance fee. Daily yield distribution via rebasing. Fully backed by US Treasuries maturing within 6 months. XAGm (tokenized silver) follows Matrixdock's Fungible Reserve Standard with custody and audit costs accounted for in supply dynamics. Source: https://www.matrixdock.com/stbt
